source_state: uncommitted speculative preparation, RNG and target-snapshot memory ownership
behavior: Prepared speculative execution acquires the exact backend domain owner before sampler, seed and cache setup, within coordinated admission and detached native recovery.

Opaque sampler, seed and random-state wrappers preserve independent ownership through clones, key derivation and mutation; a different context domain is admitted before mutation and repeated same-domain use creates no duplicate lease.

Neutral InferenceRetention carries deduplicated unquoted leases through clone, import and restore, including empty and host-only state. Restore preserves both histories without refunding request authority.

Embedded target snapshots receive complete execution context and acquire fresh ownership before copying. External target and autoregressive checkpoints retain the same protection, including context-free checkpoint calls.
Explicit deep copies establish independent completed backing for copied tensors. CPU and Metal identity tests verify source separation and native aliases retaining ownership after wrapper retirement.
Five explicit Metal scheduler tests cover same-device streams, CPU-draft/GPU-target handoff, optimistic lookahead and stochastic acceptance.
limits: Public strict budgets still reject UnknownBound. This increment establishes conservative unquoted exclusion, not complete native quotes or successful quoted-copy admission.

Prediction-extension cache snapshots still require a memory-aware context. Standalone raw logits/capture operations, exact decoder-state overlap, model/state promotion and complete paging/materialization/media/observation/distributed bounds remain outstanding.
Seven tests ignored by the selected broad native run were not explicitly executed here: five activation/component tests and two multiprocess ring tests. This is not new distributed native validation.
No released-checkpoint numerics or peak measurements were rerun for this ownership increment. Existing Qwen reference records remain separate.
Final feature check retains 12 existing unused-helper warnings. Native linking retains the existing large unwind-table warning.
One portable facade tokenizer/template fixture was ignored because EREDU_LFM2_TOOL_CHECKPOINT was unset; the other 111 portable facade and backend conformance tests passed.
corrected_validation_findings: Initial test compilation exposed private stream construction and an error-source lifetime; tests now use public stream construction and explicit borrowed lifetimes.

The first executable run passed 122 tests and found two copied descriptors lacked completed certified backing. Explicit evaluation resolved certification, exposing shared allocation identity in the same two tests.

MLX ordinary copy can alias source storage. The shared speculative copy helper now uses contiguous staging plus explicit deep_clone and establishes completion on the returned descriptor; all 124 selected native tests pass.
